# ghost/myne

Search and read public Gutenberg catalog metadata in Myne without ebook downloads, files or reader

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/myne
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/myne open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/myne search_books --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/myne read_results --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/myne open_book --device <serial> --param index=<index>
ghost skill run ghost/myne read_book --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/myne back_to_catalog --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the Project Gutenberg catalog without downloading a book
- `search_books`: Search the public catalog by title
- `read_results`: Read the first two complete exposed catalog rows
- `open_book`: Open a complete catalog row as book metadata only
- `read_book`: Read book title, author and literal metadata badges
- `back_to_catalog`: Return from book metadata to All Books; the app clears the search
